score_rationale: DiscDiff's most portable contribution — the Absorb-Escape refinement algorithm (Table 3 + Fig 4) — is FULLY reproduced and mechanically verified on CPU with no weights (repairs a TATT->TATA valley exactly, is a no-op when confident, and only touches low-confidence regions). The DiscDiff LDM (two-stage CNN-VAE + latent U-Net + DDPM eps-objective, Eq 2) is built and structurally verified (forward pass, finite CE+KL/MSE loss, one reverse step on tiny CPU configs). Held below higher because the generation METRICS (S-FID 3.21/4.38, CorTATA on 50k samples) require trained DiscDiff weights + fine-tuned Hyena + the Sei model + EPD-GenDNA and are not reproduced here (offered as a Colab run). Not lowered further because the verified algorithm is exact and the LDM structure is correct; all gated items are disclosed, none fabricated.

pipeline_run.path_executed: latent DDPM sample (1000 steps) -> VAE decode -> Absorb-Escape refine -> metrics
pipeline_run.interpretation: Proves the full pipeline runs end-to-end. Metrics are NOT paper-comparable (random model has no motif structure -> CorTATA~0 is the correct untrained result). Supply trained weights + Sei + real EPD-GenDNA for paper numbers.
pipeline_run.honesty: No number presented as paper-comparable; untrained + synthetic clearly labeled at every layer.

components_verified: Absorb condition A(s_i)=[L(D,s_i)<T_absorb] fires exactly at low-confidence positions (Table 3)
Natural escape E(s_j)=[L(D,s_j)>L(M,s_j)] stops when diffusion regains confidence (Table 3 default)
Absorb-Escape repairs a synthetic 'valley' (Fig 4: TATT -> TATA) to match the intended sequence EXACTLY
Absorb-Escape is a no-op on an all-confident sequence (safety)
Absorb-Escape modifies only the low-confidence region (locality; confident flanks preserved)
Two-stage CNN-VAE encode/decode shapes + finite CE recon + KL loss (Sec 4.1.1-4.1.2)
Latent U-Net eps-prediction shape + species/time cross-attention; DDPM eps-loss + one reverse step (Eq 2)
CorTATA=1 for identical motif distributions; Delta-Div=0 when generated matches natural; S-FID gated -> None without Sei
algorithm_verification.note: Absorb-Escape — the paper's reusable post-training refinement — is fully verified mechanically without weights; the LDM is instantiated and its forward pass confirmed.

metric_comparisons.note: S-FID needs the Sei genomic embedder + trained DiscDiff/Hyena weights + EPD-GenDNA. Implemented; returns None without Sei. Not reproduced this run.
CorTATA on 50k generated samples needs trained weights + EPD-GenDNA. Metric implemented (verified =1 on identical dists); real value gated.
